legislation_propositions.proposition_text: Where phosphorus soil sampling has not been carried out within four years before derogation grant, sampling must be carried out on 75% of the agricultural area no later than 12 months after the grant of the derogation.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Initial phosphorus sampling requirement (75% within 12 months)
legislation_propositions.label: Initial phosphorus sampling requirement (75% within 12 months)

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: Where phosphorus soil sampling has not been carried out within four years before derogation grant, sampling must be carried out on 100% of the agricultural area no later than 12 months after the date on which a derogation is next granted to the occupier.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Complete phosphorus sampling requirement (100% at next derogation)
legislation_propositions.label: Complete phosphorus sampling requirement (100% at next derogation)

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: Before spreading organic manure, the occupier must record the total phosphate content of the organic manure and the amount of phosphate likely to be supplied from the organic manure intended to be spread for the purpose of fertilising the crop in the growing season in which it is spread.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Recording requirements before spreading organic manure
legislation_propositions.label: Recording requirements before spreading organic manure

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: Before spreading manufactured phosphate fertiliser, the occupier must record the amount required (that is, the optimum amount of phosphate required by the crop less the amount of phosphate that will be supplied for crop uptake from any organic manure spread).
legislation_propositions.short_name: Recording phosphate amount required before spreading manufactured fertiliser
legislation_propositions.label: Recording phosphate amount required before spreading manufactured fertiliser

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: Before spreading manufactured phosphate fertiliser, the occupier must record the month in which it is planned to do the spreading.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Recording planned spreading month for manufactured phosphate fertiliser
legislation_propositions.label: Recording planned spreading month for manufactured phosphate fertiliser

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: The risk map for the holding must show each field marked with a reference number or letter to enable cross-reference to fields recorded in the fertilisation plan.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Risk map: field reference marking
legislation_propositions.label: Risk map: field reference marking

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: The risk map for the holding must correspond with the agricultural area of the holding.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Risk map: correspondence with agricultural area
legislation_propositions.label: Risk map: correspondence with agricultural area

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: The risk map for the holding must be completed by 1st March in the calendar year to which it relates.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Risk map: completion deadline
legislation_propositions.label: Risk map: completion deadline

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: Where a change in circumstances affects a matter referred to in paragraph (1), the occupier must update the risk map within one month of the change.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Risk map: update obligation on change
legislation_propositions.label: Risk map: update obligation on change

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: The occupier must maintain the holding to ensure at least 80% of the agricultural area is sown with grass during the calendar year to which the derogation applies.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Minimum grass coverage requirement for derogation
legislation_propositions.label: Minimum grass coverage requirement for derogation

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: Any temporary grassland on sandy soils on the holding must not be ploughed between 1st July and the following 31st December.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Prohibition on ploughing temporary grassland on sandy soils (1 July – 31 December)
legislation_propositions.label: Prohibition on ploughing temporary grassland on sandy soils (1 July – 31 December)

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: Where livestock manure has been spread on grass on sandy soils on the holding between 1st September and 31st December, the grass must not be ploughed before the following 16th January.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Prohibition on ploughing grass on sandy soils after manure spreading (until 16 January)
legislation_propositions.label: Prohibition on ploughing grass on sandy soils after manure spreading (until 16 January)

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: Where livestock manure has been spread on grass not on sandy soils on the holding between 15th October and the following 15th January, the grass must not be ploughed before the following 16th January.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Prohibition on ploughing grass not on sandy soils after manure spreading (until 16 January)
legislation_propositions.label: Prohibition on ploughing grass not on sandy soils after manure spreading (until 16 January)

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: Where any grass on the holding is ploughed, the land must be sown with a crop with high nitrogen demand within four weeks beginning with the day after the ploughing.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Ploughed grass land – sowing with high nitrogen demand crop (4 weeks)
legislation_propositions.label: Ploughed grass land – sowing with high nitrogen demand crop (4 weeks)

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: A crop with high nitrogen demand includes grass, potatoes, sugar beet, maize, wheat, oilseed rape, barley, brassica, rye and triticale.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Definition – crop with high nitrogen demand
legislation_propositions.label: Definition – crop with high nitrogen demand

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: Crop rotation on the holding must not include leguminous or other plants fixing atmospheric nitrogen, except for grass with less than 50% clover or any other leguminous plant that is under-sown with grass.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Prohibition on leguminous crops in rotation with exceptions
legislation_propositions.label: Prohibition on leguminous crops in rotation with exceptions

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: The occupier must record the total agricultural area and the area of grass within the holding by 1st March for each calendar year.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Annual recording of agricultural area and grass area by 1st March
legislation_propositions.label: Annual recording of agricultural area and grass area by 1st March

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: If the size of the holding or the area of grass within it changes, the occupier must update the record within one month beginning with the day after the day of the change.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Update record within one month of change in holding or grass area
legislation_propositions.label: Update record within one month of change in holding or grass area

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: The occupier must make a record describing the livestock housing and manure storage systems together with the volume of manure storage in place on the holding by 1st March for each calendar year.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Annual record of livestock housing and manure storage by 1 March
legislation_propositions.label: Annual record of livestock housing and manure storage by 1 March

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: The occupier must record the expected number of livestock animals to be kept on the holding during the calendar year to which the derogation relates, and the category for each animal by reference to the categories in Schedule 1.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Record expected livestock numbers and categories
legislation_propositions.label: Record expected livestock numbers and categories

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: Having complied with the duty to record expected livestock numbers, the occupier must calculate and record the amount of nitrogen and phosphate in manure expected to be produced by the livestock on the holding during that year by reference to Schedule 1.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Calculate and record expected nitrogen and phosphate in manure
legislation_propositions.label: Calculate and record expected nitrogen and phosphate in manure

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: A record required under paragraph 14 must be made by 1st March for the calendar year concerned.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Deadline for making records
legislation_propositions.label: Deadline for making records

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: The occupier must make a record of the type and amount of livestock manure that is intended to be brought on to the holding and sent off the holding during the calendar year to which the derogation relates.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Record livestock manure movements (derogation)
legislation_propositions.label: Record livestock manure movements (derogation)

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: The occupier must calculate and record the amount of nitrogen in the livestock manure recorded under paragraph (a) in accordance with Part 1 or 2 of Schedule 2.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Calculate and record nitrogen in livestock manure (derogation)
legislation_propositions.label: Calculate and record nitrogen in livestock manure (derogation)

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: A record required under paragraph 15 must be made by 1st March for the calendar year concerned.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Deadline for livestock manure records (derogation)
legislation_propositions.label: Deadline for livestock manure records (derogation)

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: The occupier must, within one week of sowing a crop on which nitrogen fertiliser is or will be spread, record the crop sown and the date of sowing.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Record-keeping obligation for crops receiving nitrogen fertiliser
legislation_propositions.label: Record-keeping obligation for crops receiving nitrogen fertiliser

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: The occupier must record the total phosphorus content within one week of spreading organic manure.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Record total phosphorus content within one week of spreading organic manure
legislation_propositions.label: Record total phosphorus content within one week of spreading organic manure

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: The occupier must record the amount of phosphate that was supplied for uptake by the crop within one week of spreading organic manure.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Record phosphate supplied for crop uptake within one week of spreading organic manure
legislation_propositions.label: Record phosphate supplied for crop uptake within one week of spreading organic manure

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: The occupier must record the date of spreading within one week of spreading manufactured phosphate fertiliser.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Record date of spreading manufactured phosphate fertiliser within one week
legislation_propositions.label: Record date of spreading manufactured phosphate fertiliser within one week

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: The occupier must record the amount of phosphate spread within one week of spreading manufactured phosphate fertiliser.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Record amount of phosphate spread from manufactured fertiliser within one week
legislation_propositions.label: Record amount of phosphate spread from manufactured fertiliser within one week

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: The occupier must record the date of ploughing within one week of ploughing on the holding.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Record-keeping obligation for ploughing date
legislation_propositions.label: Record-keeping obligation for ploughing date

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: The occupier must prepare accounts for the calendar year to which the derogation relates and submit them to the Agency by 30th April of the following year.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Derogation accounts: preparation and submission deadline
legislation_propositions.label: Derogation accounts: preparation and submission deadline

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: The accounts must be in the form and manner published by the Agency.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Derogation accounts: form and manner requirement
legislation_propositions.label: Derogation accounts: form and manner requirement

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: The accounts must record the total agricultural area of the holding and the area covered by specified crop types including winter wheat, spring wheat, winter barley, spring barley, winter oilseed rape, sugar beet, potatoes, forage maize, grass, and other crops.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Derogation accounts: agricultural area and crop recording
legislation_propositions.label: Derogation accounts: agricultural area and crop recording

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: The accounts must record the number and category of animals kept on the holding, the amount of nitrogen and phosphate in manure produced by those animals, the amount, type and characteristics of livestock manure brought on to or sent off the holding, the nitrogen and phosphate content of that manure, and the weight and nitrogen content of manufactured nitrogen fertiliser stocks and movements between 1st January and 31st December.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Derogation accounts: livestock, manure and fertiliser recording
legislation_propositions.label: Derogation accounts: livestock, manure and fertiliser recording

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: Regulations 7, 8, 10, 11, 12, 13, 15, 16, 17, 19, 23, 25A, 25B, 26, 27, 28, 29, 30, 31, 32, and 34 do not apply to a new holding until the beginning of the second calendar year after the year in which the Secretary of State revises or adds to the designation of nitrate vulnerable zones under regulation 4(5) so as to include the new holding.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Transitional exemption for new holdings in nitrate vulnerable zones
legislation_propositions.label: Transitional exemption for new holdings in nitrate vulnerable zones

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: Regulation 18 (restrictions on spreading slurry) does not apply in relation to a new holding until 31st July in the third calendar year after the year in which the Secretary of State revises or adds to the designation of nitrate vulnerable zones under regulation 4(5) so as to include the new holding.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Transitional exemption from slurry spreading restrictions for new holdings
legislation_propositions.label: Transitional exemption from slurry spreading restrictions for new holdings

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: The Water Resources (Control of Agricultural Pollution) (Wales) Regulations 2021 apply in relation to Wales.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Territorial application
legislation_propositions.label: Territorial application

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: The Water Resources (Control of Agricultural Pollution) (Wales) Regulations 2021 come into force on 1 April 2021.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Commencement date
legislation_propositions.label: Commencement date

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: In a holding or part of a holding that was not previously situated within a nitrate vulnerable zone as shown on the NVZ index map 2013, regulations 5 to 11, 15, 23, 27, 33 to 35, and 37 to 43 do not apply until 1 January 2023.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Transitional non-application of specified regulations until 1 January 2023 for newly designated NVZ holdings
legislation_propositions.label: Transitional non-application of specified regulations until 1 January 2023 for newly designated NVZ holdings

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: In a holding or part of a holding that was not previously situated within a nitrate vulnerable zone as shown on the NVZ index map 2013, regulations 4 and 36 do not apply until 1 January 2024, except that regulation 4 does not apply to qualifying grassland holdings until 1 January 2025.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Transitional non-application of regulations 4 and 36 until 1 January 2024 (or 2025 for qualifying grassland) for newly designated NVZ holdings
legislation_propositions.label: Transitional non-application of regulations 4 and 36 until 1 January 2024 (or 2025 for qualifying grassland) for newly designated NVZ holdings

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: In a holding or part of a holding that was not previously situated within a nitrate vulnerable zone as shown on the NVZ index map 2013, regulations 17 to 21, 25, 26, and 28 to 31 do not apply until 1 August 2024.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Transitional non-application of specified regulations until 1 August 2024 for newly designated NVZ holdings
legislation_propositions.label: Transitional non-application of specified regulations until 1 August 2024 for newly designated NVZ holdings

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: The occupier of a holding must ensure that in any year beginning 1 January, the total amount of nitrogen in livestock manure applied to the holding (whether directly by an animal or by spreading) does not exceed 170 kg multiplied by the area of the holding in hectares.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Annual nitrogen limit from livestock manure
legislation_propositions.label: Annual nitrogen limit from livestock manure

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: The amount of nitrogen produced by livestock must be calculated in accordance with Schedule 1.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Nitrogen calculation methodology
legislation_propositions.label: Nitrogen calculation methodology

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: In calculating the area of the holding for the purposes of ascertaining the amount of nitrogen permitted to be spread on the holding, no account is taken of surface waters, any hardstanding, buildings, roads or any woodland unless that woodland is used for grazing.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Exclusions from holding area calculation
legislation_propositions.label: Exclusions from holding area calculation

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: The occupier of a qualifying grassland holding must ensure that during the relevant period the area of the holding (in hectares) is greater than or equal to the total nitrogen in grazing livestock manure divided by 250 plus or minus the total nitrogen in non-grazing livestock manure divided by 170.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Nitrogen application formula for qualifying grassland holdings
legislation_propositions.label: Nitrogen application formula for qualifying grassland holdings

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: Where the occupier of a qualifying grassland holding intends to apply nitrogen in grazing livestock manure exceeding 170 kg multiplied by the area of the holding in hectares, they must submit a notice to NRW in accordance with regulation 4B.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Notice requirement for exceeding 170 kg nitrogen threshold
legislation_propositions.label: Notice requirement for exceeding 170 kg nitrogen threshold

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: In calculating the area of a holding for nitrogen spreading purposes, no account is taken of surface waters, any hardstanding, buildings, roads or any woodland (unless that woodland is used for grazing).
legislation_propositions.short_name: Exclusions from holding area calculation
legislation_propositions.label: Exclusions from holding area calculation

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: A notice under this regulation must include the name of the occupier of the qualifying grassland holding, the address of the qualifying grassland holding, a written statement that the occupier intends during the relevant period to apply to the holding a total amount of nitrogen in grazing livestock manure which exceeds 170 kg multiplied by the area of the holding in hectares, and a written statement that the occupier will comply with the additional requirements set out in Schedule 1A.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Content requirements for notice under regulation 4B
legislation_propositions.label: Content requirements for notice under regulation 4B

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: A notice must be submitted to NRW by 31 March 2024 and must be accompanied by the enhanced nutrient management plan for the qualifying grassland holding.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Deadline and accompanying document for notice submission
legislation_propositions.label: Deadline and accompanying document for notice submission

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: The notice and accompanying enhanced nutrient management plan must be submitted to NRW by e-mail.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Method of submission for notice and plan
legislation_propositions.label: Method of submission for notice and plan

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: The occupier of a holding must ensure that, in any 12 month period, the total amount of nitrogen in organic manure spread on any given hectare on the holding does not exceed 250 kg, subject to exceptions for certified compost.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Annual nitrogen limit for organic manure (250 kg/ha)
legislation_propositions.label: Annual nitrogen limit for organic manure (250 kg/ha)

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: The occupier of a holding must ensure that the total amount of nitrogen in organic manure exclusively in the form of certified compost applied as mulch to orchard land does not exceed 1000 kg in any four year period.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Nitrogen limit for certified compost on orchard land (1000 kg/4 years)
legislation_propositions.label: Nitrogen limit for certified compost on orchard land (1000 kg/4 years)

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: The occupier of a holding must ensure that the total amount of nitrogen in organic manure exclusively in the form of certified compost applied to any land other than orchard land does not exceed 500 kg in any two year period.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Nitrogen limit for certified compost on other land (500 kg/2 years)
legislation_propositions.label: Nitrogen limit for certified compost on other land (500 kg/2 years)

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: Certified compost means green compost or green/food compost in relation to which the supplier confirms in writing that it meets the standards set out in PAS 100:2011 and contains no livestock manure, and the occupier must retain that written confirmation.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Definition of certified compost and retention requirement
legislation_propositions.label: Definition of certified compost and retention requirement

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: Before spreading organic manure, the occupier must on each occasion calculate the amount of nitrogen from that manure that is likely to be available for crop uptake in the growing season in which it is spread.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Calculation of available nitrogen from organic manure before spreading
legislation_propositions.label: Calculation of available nitrogen from organic manure before spreading

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: Before spreading organic manure, the occupier must record the area on which the organic manure will be spread, the quantity of organic manure to be spread, the planned date for spreading (month), the type of organic manure, the total nitrogen content, and the amount of nitrogen likely to be available from the organic manure for crop uptake in the growing season in which it is spread.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Record-keeping requirements before spreading organic manure
legislation_propositions.label: Record-keeping requirements before spreading organic manure

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: Before spreading nitrogen fertiliser, the occupier must record the amount required and the planned date for spreading (month).
legislation_propositions.short_name: Record-keeping requirements before spreading nitrogen fertiliser
legislation_propositions.label: Record-keeping requirements before spreading nitrogen fertiliser

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: An occupier must ensure that the total amount of nitrogen from manufactured nitrogen fertiliser and nitrogen available for crop uptake from organic manure spread in the growing season does not exceed the limits set out in regulation 10 in any 12 month period, irrespective of the figure in the plan.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Total nitrogen limit (manufactured fertiliser and organic manure)
legislation_propositions.label: Total nitrogen limit (manufactured fertiliser and organic manure)

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: The occupier must establish the total amount of nitrogen in livestock manure by using the table in Part 1 of Schedule 3 or by sampling and analysis in accordance with Part 2 of Schedule 3.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Nitrogen determination in livestock manure
legislation_propositions.label: Nitrogen determination in livestock manure

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: For cattle slurry, 40% of the total nitrogen in the livestock manure is assumed to be available for crop uptake in the growing season in which it is spread.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Cattle slurry nitrogen availability
legislation_propositions.label: Cattle slurry nitrogen availability

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: For pig slurry, 50% of the total nitrogen in the livestock manure is assumed to be available for crop uptake in the growing season in which it is spread.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Pig slurry nitrogen availability
legislation_propositions.label: Pig slurry nitrogen availability

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: For all other organic manure, the occupier must establish the total amount of nitrogen available for crop uptake in the growing season in which it is spread by reference to technical analyses provided by the supplier, or if unavailable, by reference to the Nutrient Management Guide (RB209), or by sampling and analysis in accordance with Part 2 of Schedule 3.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Nitrogen determination in other organic manure
legislation_propositions.label: Nitrogen determination in other organic manure

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: The total amount of nitrogen permitted to be spread on any crop is the figure given in the table, adjusted in accordance with the notes to the table and multiplied by the total area in hectares of that crop sown on the holding.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Maximum nitrogen spreading limits per crop
legislation_propositions.label: Maximum nitrogen spreading limits per crop

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: An additional 80 kg per hectare of nitrogen is permitted to all crops grown in fields if the current or previous crop has had straw or paper sludge applied to it.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Additional nitrogen for straw/paper sludge application
legislation_propositions.label: Additional nitrogen for straw/paper sludge application

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: An additional 20 kg per hectare of nitrogen is permitted on fields with shallow soil (other than shallow soils over sandstone).
legislation_propositions.short_name: Additional nitrogen for shallow soil
legislation_propositions.label: Additional nitrogen for shallow soil

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: An additional 20 kg per hectare of nitrogen is permitted for every tonne that the expected yield exceeds the standard yield.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Additional nitrogen for yield exceeding standard
legislation_propositions.label: Additional nitrogen for yield exceeding standard

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: An occupier who intends to spread nitrogen fertiliser must first undertake a field inspection to consider the risk of nitrogen getting into surface water.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Field inspection required before spreading nitrogen fertiliser
legislation_propositions.label: Field inspection required before spreading nitrogen fertiliser

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: No person may spread nitrogen fertiliser on land if there is a significant risk of nitrogen getting into surface water, taking into account the slope of the land (particularly if more than 12°), ground cover, proximity to surface water, weather conditions, soil type, and the presence of land drains.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Prohibition on spreading nitrogen fertiliser where significant risk to surface water
legislation_propositions.label: Prohibition on spreading nitrogen fertiliser where significant risk to surface water

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: No person may spread nitrogen fertiliser if the soil is waterlogged, flooded, snow covered, frozen, or has been frozen for more than 12 hours in the previous 24 hours.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Prohibition on spreading nitrogen fertiliser in adverse soil conditions
legislation_propositions.label: Prohibition on spreading nitrogen fertiliser in adverse soil conditions

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: No person may spread manufactured nitrogen fertiliser within 2 metres of surface water.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Prohibition on spreading manufactured nitrogen fertiliser within 2 metres of surface water
legislation_propositions.label: Prohibition on spreading manufactured nitrogen fertiliser within 2 metres of surface water

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: No person may spread organic manure within 10 metres of surface water unless using precision spreading equipment, in which case no person may spread organic manure within 6 metres of surface water, except where paragraph 26 of Schedule 1A applies.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Organic manure spreading – minimum distance from surface water
legislation_propositions.label: Organic manure spreading – minimum distance from surface water

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: Livestock manure (other than slurry and poultry manure) may be spread within 10 metres of surface water if it is spread on land managed for breeding wader birds or as species-rich semi-natural grassland that is notified as a SSSI or subject to an agri-environment commitment, spread between 1 June and 31 October inclusive, not spread directly on to surface water, and the total annual amount does not exceed 12.5 tonnes per hectare.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Livestock manure spreading – exception for conservation land
legislation_propositions.label: Livestock manure spreading – exception for conservation land

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: No person may spread organic manure within 50 metres of a borehole, spring or well.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Organic manure spreading – minimum distance from water sources
legislation_propositions.label: Organic manure spreading – minimum distance from water sources

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: Any person spreading slurry must use spreading equipment with a low spreading trajectory, that is, below 4 metres from the ground.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Slurry spreading equipment trajectory requirement
legislation_propositions.label: Slurry spreading equipment trajectory requirement

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: Spreading equipment with a spreading trajectory of more than 4 metres from the ground may be used on land that has a low run off risk where such equipment can achieve an average slurry application rate of not more than 2 mm per hour when it is operating continuously.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Exception for high-trajectory slurry spreading equipment
legislation_propositions.label: Exception for high-trajectory slurry spreading equipment

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: Any person spreading nitrogen fertiliser must do so in as accurate a manner as possible.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Nitrogen fertiliser spreading accuracy requirement
legislation_propositions.label: Nitrogen fertiliser spreading accuracy requirement

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: Any person who applies organic manure onto the surface of bare soil or stubble (other than soil that has been sown) must ensure that it is incorporated into the soil in accordance with this regulation.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Duty to incorporate organic manure applied to bare soil or stubble
legislation_propositions.label: Duty to incorporate organic manure applied to bare soil or stubble

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: Poultry manure must be incorporated as soon as practicable, and within 24 hours at the latest.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Incorporation timing for poultry manure
legislation_propositions.label: Incorporation timing for poultry manure

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: Slurry and liquid digested sewage sludge must be incorporated as soon as practicable, and within 24 hours at the latest, unless it was applied using equipment of a type described in regulation 14(4).
legislation_propositions.short_name: Incorporation timing for slurry and liquid digested sewage sludge
legislation_propositions.label: Incorporation timing for slurry and liquid digested sewage sludge

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: Any other organic manure (other than organic manure spread as a mulch on sandy soil) must be incorporated into the soil as soon as practicable, and within 24 hours at the latest, if the land is within 50 metres of surface water and slopes in such a way that there may be run-off to that water.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Incorporation timing for other organic manure near surface water
legislation_propositions.label: Incorporation timing for other organic manure near surface water

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: Organic manure with high readily available nitrogen is defined as organic manure in which more than 30% of the total nitrogen content is available to the crop at the time of spreading.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Definition of organic manure with high readily available nitrogen
legislation_propositions.label: Definition of organic manure with high readily available nitrogen

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: Spreading organic manure with high readily available nitrogen on tillage land with sandy or shallow soil is permitted between 1 August and 15 September inclusive, provided that the crop is sown on or before 15 September.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Permitted spreading of high readily available nitrogen organic manure on sandy/shallow tillage land (1 Aug–15 Sep) if crop sown by 15 Sep
legislation_propositions.label: Permitted spreading of high readily available nitrogen organic manure on sandy/shallow tillage land (1 Aug–15 Sep) if crop sown by 15 Sep

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: An occupier of a holding who has submitted an undertaking to the organic control system under Council Regulation (EC) 834/2007 may spread organic manure with high readily available nitrogen at any time on crops listed in Schedule 4 (permitted crops for the closed period), provided that each hectare does not receive more than 150 kg total nitrogen between the start of the closed period and the end of February.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Organic manure spreading on Schedule 4 crops during closed period
legislation_propositions.label: Organic manure spreading on Schedule 4 crops during closed period

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: An occupier of a holding who has submitted an undertaking to the organic control system under Council Regulation (EC) 834/2007 may spread organic manure with high readily available nitrogen at any time on other crops (not listed in Schedule 4) in accordance with written advice from a FACTS-qualified person, provided that each hectare does not receive more than 150 kg total nitrogen between the start of the closed period and the end of February.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Organic manure spreading on other crops with FACTS advice during closed period
legislation_propositions.label: Organic manure spreading on other crops with FACTS advice during closed period

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: From the end of the closed period until the end of February, the maximum amount of slurry that may be spread at any one time is 30 cubic metres per hectare.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Maximum slurry spreading limit (end of closed period to end of February)
legislation_propositions.label: Maximum slurry spreading limit (end of closed period to end of February)

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: From the end of the closed period until the end of February, the maximum amount of poultry manure that may be spread at any one time is 8 tonnes per hectare.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Maximum poultry manure spreading limit (end of closed period to end of February)
legislation_propositions.label: Maximum poultry manure spreading limit (end of closed period to end of February)

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: From the end of the closed period until the end of February, there must be at least three weeks between each spreading.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Minimum interval between spreading events (end of closed period to end of February)
legislation_propositions.label: Minimum interval between spreading events (end of closed period to end of February)

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: No person may spread manufactured nitrogen fertiliser on grassland from 15 September to 15 January (inclusive).
legislation_propositions.short_name: Prohibition on spreading manufactured nitrogen fertiliser on grassland during closed period
legislation_propositions.label: Prohibition on spreading manufactured nitrogen fertiliser on grassland during closed period

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: Spreading manufactured nitrogen fertiliser during the closed periods is permitted on crops specified in Schedule 4 Table provided the maximum rate in column 2 is not exceeded.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Exception permitting spreading on Schedule 4 crops subject to maximum rate
legislation_propositions.label: Exception permitting spreading on Schedule 4 crops subject to maximum rate

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: Spreading manufactured nitrogen fertiliser during the closed periods on crops not in Schedule 4 is permitted on the basis of written advice from a person who is a member of the Fertiliser Advisers Certification and Training Scheme.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Exception permitting spreading on non-Schedule 4 crops with FACTS advice
legislation_propositions.label: Exception permitting spreading on non-Schedule 4 crops with FACTS advice

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: An occupier of a holding who stores organic manure (other than slurry) must store it in a vessel, in a covered building, on an impermeable surface, or (for solid manure that can be stacked in a free-standing heap and does not drain liquid) on a temporary field site.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Storage requirements for organic manure (excluding slurry)
legislation_propositions.label: Storage requirements for organic manure (excluding slurry)

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: A person with custody or control of silage being made or stored must keep it in a silo satisfying Schedule 5 requirements, or compress it into bales wrapped in impermeable membranes and stored at least 10 metres from inland freshwaters or coastal waters, or (for field silage on open land) give NRW 14 days' notice and ensure the place is at least 10 metres from inland freshwaters or coastal waters and at least 50 metres from the nearest relevant water abstraction point of any protected water supply source.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Silage storage requirements
legislation_propositions.label: Silage storage requirements

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: A water supply source is a protected water supply source if any relevant water abstraction from it is licensed under Part 2 of the Water Resources Act 1991, or if the person making or storing the silage was aware of the source's location before the silage-making began or (if made elsewhere) before it was stored on the land.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Protected water supply source definition
legislation_propositions.label: Protected water supply source definition

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: A person with custody or control of a silage bale must not open or remove the wrapping of the bale within 10 metres of any inland freshwaters or coastal waters which silage effluent could enter as a result.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Prohibition on opening silage bales near waters
legislation_propositions.label: Prohibition on opening silage bales near waters

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: Relevant water abstraction means the abstraction of water for use for human consumption, or domestic purposes (other than human consumption), or manufacturing food or drink for human consumption.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Relevant water abstraction definition
legislation_propositions.label: Relevant water abstraction definition

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: A person having custody or control of slurry must have a slurry storage system that satisfies the requirements of Schedule 6.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Slurry storage system requirement
legislation_propositions.label: Slurry storage system requirement

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: Slurry must be stored in a slurry storage system that satisfies the requirements of Schedule 6.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Slurry storage location requirement
legislation_propositions.label: Slurry storage location requirement

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: The requirement to have a compliant slurry storage system and to store slurry in that system does not apply to slurry while it is stored temporarily in a tanker that is used for transporting slurry on roads or about a farm.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Exception for temporary storage in transport tankers
legislation_propositions.label: Exception for temporary storage in transport tankers

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: Regulations 24(1) and 25(1) do not apply to a silo or slurry storage system which, before 1 March 1991, was being used for the purpose of making silage or storing slurry.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Exemption for silos/slurry storage systems in use before 1 March 1991
legislation_propositions.label: Exemption for silos/slurry storage systems in use before 1 March 1991

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: Regulations 24(1) and 25(1) do not apply to a silo or slurry storage system which was constructed before 1 March 1991 for the purpose of making silage or storing slurry, even if not used before that date.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Exemption for silos/slurry storage systems constructed before 1 March 1991
legislation_propositions.label: Exemption for silos/slurry storage systems constructed before 1 March 1991

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: Regulations 24(1) and 25(1) do not apply to a silo or slurry storage system where a contract for its construction, substantial enlargement or substantial reconstruction was entered into before 1 March 1991 and the work was completed before 1 September 1991.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Exemption for silos/slurry storage systems contracted before 1 March 1991 and completed before 1 September 1991
legislation_propositions.label: Exemption for silos/slurry storage systems contracted before 1 March 1991 and completed before 1 September 1991

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: Regulations 24(1) and 25(1) do not apply to a silo or slurry storage system where construction, substantial enlargement or substantial reconstruction work was commenced before 1 March 1991 and the work was completed before 1 September 1991.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Exemption for silos/slurry storage systems with work commenced before 1 March 1991 and completed before 1 September 1991
legislation_propositions.label: Exemption for silos/slurry storage systems with work commenced before 1 March 1991 and completed before 1 September 1991

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: A temporary field site must not be in a field liable to flooding or becoming waterlogged, within 50 metres of a borehole, spring or well or within 10 metres of surface water or a land drain (other than a sealed impermeable pipe), located in any single position for more than 12 consecutive months, or located in the same place as an earlier one constructed within the last two years.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Temporary field site location prohibitions
legislation_propositions.label: Temporary field site location prohibitions

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: Solid poultry manure that does not have bedding mixed into it and is stored on a temporary field site must be covered with an impermeable material.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Solid poultry manure covering requirement
legislation_propositions.label: Solid poultry manure covering requirement

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: Topsoil must not be removed from the ground upon which a temporary field site is to be constructed.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Topsoil removal prohibition
legislation_propositions.label: Topsoil removal prohibition

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: A temporary field site must not be located within 30 metres of a watercourse on land identified on the risk map as having an incline of greater than 12°, and the surface area of a temporary field site must be as small as reasonably practicable to minimise the leaching effect of rainfall.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Watercourse proximity and surface area requirements
legislation_propositions.label: Watercourse proximity and surface area requirements

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: Separation of slurry into its solid and liquid fractions must be carried out mechanically or on an impermeable surface where the liquid fraction drains into a suitable receptacle.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Slurry separation requirements
legislation_propositions.label: Slurry separation requirements

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: An occupier of a holding who keeps any of the animals specified in Schedule 1 must provide sufficient storage for all slurry produced on the holding during the storage period, and all poultry manure produced in a yard or building on the holding during the storage period.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Duty to provide sufficient slurry and poultry manure storage
legislation_propositions.label: Duty to provide sufficient slurry and poultry manure storage

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: A slurry store must have the capacity to store, in addition to the manure, any rainfall, washings or other liquid that enters the vessel (either directly or indirectly) during the storage period.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Slurry store capacity must include rainfall and washings
legislation_propositions.label: Slurry store capacity must include rainfall and washings

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: Storage facilities are not necessary for slurry or poultry manure sent off the holding or spread on land that has a low run-off risk (provided that spreading is done in accordance with the restrictions on spreading in these Regulations), but in this case storage facilities for an additional one week's manure must be provided as a contingency measure.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Exception to storage requirement for manure sent off or spread, with contingency
legislation_propositions.label: Exception to storage requirement for manure sent off or spread, with contingency

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: For the purposes of regulation 29, the storage period is (a) the period between 1 October and 1 April (all dates inclusive) for pigs and poultry, and (b) the period between 1 October and 1 March (all dates inclusive) in any other case.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Definition of 'storage period' for slurry and manure storage
legislation_propositions.label: Definition of 'storage period' for slurry and manure storage

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: A person served with a regulation 30 notice may appeal to the Welsh Ministers within 28 days beginning on the day after the date on which the notice is served, or such longer period as the Welsh Ministers allow.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Right to appeal regulation 30 notice within 28 days
legislation_propositions.label: Right to appeal regulation 30 notice within 28 days

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: An appeal under regulation 31 must be made by the appellant serving notice on the Welsh Ministers, and the notice must contain or be accompanied by a statement of the grounds of appeal.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Appeal procedure requires notice with grounds
legislation_propositions.label: Appeal procedure requires notice with grounds

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: On determining an appeal under regulation 31, the Welsh Ministers may direct NRW to withdraw the regulation 30 notice, modify any of its requirements, extend the period for compliance with any requirement, or dismiss the appeal.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Welsh Ministers' powers on determining appeal
legislation_propositions.label: Welsh Ministers' powers on determining appeal

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: The period for compliance with a regulation 30 notice against which an appeal has been made is extended so that it expires on the date on which the Welsh Ministers finally determines the appeal or, if the appeal is withdrawn, the date on which it is withdrawn, subject to any direction under paragraph (5).
legislation_propositions.short_name: Automatic extension of compliance period during appeal
legislation_propositions.label: Automatic extension of compliance period during appeal

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: Regulation 32 applies to any silo or slurry storage system whose construction is to be begun on or after 28 April 2021.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Application of regulation 32 to new or improved silos and slurry storage systems
legislation_propositions.label: Application of regulation 32 to new or improved silos and slurry storage systems

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: A person who proposes to have custody or control of silage or slurry that is to be kept in a new or improved store must give NRW notice specifying the type of silo or storage system and its location, at least 14 days before work constructing the new or improved store is to be begun.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Duty to notify NRW before constructing new or improved silage or slurry store
legislation_propositions.label: Duty to notify NRW before constructing new or improved silage or slurry store

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: For the purposes of regulation 32, 'construction' includes substantial enlargement and reconstruction.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Definition of 'construction' in regulation 32
legislation_propositions.label: Definition of 'construction' in regulation 32

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: The occupier of a holding must maintain a record of the total size of the holding calculated in accordance with regulation 4(3).
legislation_propositions.short_name: Duty to maintain holding size record
legislation_propositions.label: Duty to maintain holding size record

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: If the size of the holding changes, the record must be updated within one month.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Duty to update holding size record within one month of change
legislation_propositions.label: Duty to update holding size record within one month of change

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: The occupier of a holding with livestock must maintain a record of the amount of manure that will be produced by the anticipated number of animals that will be kept in a building or on hardstanding during the storage period, using the figures in Schedule 1.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Duty to record anticipated manure production
legislation_propositions.label: Duty to record anticipated manure production

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: The occupier of a holding with livestock must maintain a record of the amount of storage capacity (slurry vessels and hardstanding) required to enable compliance with regulation 29, taking into account the amount of manure intended to be exported from the holding, the amount of manure intended to be spread on land that has a low run-off risk, and in the case of a slurry vessel the amount of liquid other than slurry likely to enter the vessel.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Duty to record required storage capacity with adjustments
legislation_propositions.label: Duty to record required storage capacity with adjustments

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: An occupier who introduces animals on to a holding for the first time must comply with the record-keeping requirements within one month of the introduction of the animals.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Time limit for first-time livestock introduction record-keeping
legislation_propositions.label: Time limit for first-time livestock introduction record-keeping

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: If the amount of storage capacity changes, the occupier must record the change within one week.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Duty to record storage capacity changes within one week
legislation_propositions.label: Duty to record storage capacity changes within one week

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: The occupier of a holding with livestock must, before 30 April each year, record for the previous storage period the number and category of animals in a building or on a hardstanding during the storage period.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Annual livestock record-keeping obligation
legislation_propositions.label: Annual livestock record-keeping obligation

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: The occupier of a holding with livestock must record the sites used for field heaps and the dates of use.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Field heap site and date record-keeping obligation
legislation_propositions.label: Field heap site and date record-keeping obligation

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: Before the relevant date every year, the occupier must record the number and category of animals on the holding during the previous 12 month period and the number of days each animal spent on the holding.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Annual animal record obligation
legislation_propositions.label: Annual animal record obligation

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: The occupier must calculate the amount of nitrogen in the manure produced by the animals on the holding during that year using the Table in Schedule 1.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Nitrogen calculation using Schedule 1
legislation_propositions.label: Nitrogen calculation using Schedule 1

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: For permanently housed pigs or poultry, the occupier may alternatively use approved software or, for systems producing only solid manure, sampling and analysis in accordance with Part 2 of Schedule 3.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Alternative nitrogen calculation methods
legislation_propositions.label: Alternative nitrogen calculation methods

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: The occupier must make a record of the calculations and how the final figures were arrived at.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Record of calculation methodology
legislation_propositions.label: Record of calculation methodology

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: An occupier who brings livestock manure on to a holding must, within one week, record the type and amount of livestock manure, the date it is brought on to the holding, the nitrogen content, and if known the name and address of the supplier.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Record-keeping for livestock manure brought onto holding
legislation_propositions.label: Record-keeping for livestock manure brought onto holding

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: An occupier who sends livestock manure off a holding must within one week record the type and amount of livestock manure, the date it is sent off the holding, the nitrogen content, the name and address of the recipient, and details of a contingency plan to be used in the event that an agreement for a person to accept the livestock manure fails.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Record-keeping for livestock manure sent off holding
legislation_propositions.label: Record-keeping for livestock manure sent off holding

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: If the nitrogen content of the livestock manure brought on to a holding is not known, the occupier must ascertain it as soon as is reasonably practicable after arrival and record it within one week of ascertaining it.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Duty to ascertain and record unknown nitrogen content
legislation_propositions.label: Duty to ascertain and record unknown nitrogen content

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: All nitrogen content of the livestock manure must be ascertained using either the standard figures in Part 1 of Schedule 3 or by sampling and analysis as set out in Part 2 of that Schedule.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Methods for ascertaining nitrogen content
legislation_propositions.label: Methods for ascertaining nitrogen content

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: Any person using sampling and analysis to determine nitrogen content in organic manure must keep the original laboratory report.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Duty to retain original laboratory report for nitrogen content analysis in organic manure
legislation_propositions.label: Duty to retain original laboratory report for nitrogen content analysis in organic manure

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: An occupier who intends to spread nitrogen fertiliser must record the crop sown within one week of sowing a crop.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Record crop sown within one week
legislation_propositions.label: Record crop sown within one week

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: An occupier who intends to spread nitrogen fertiliser must record the date of sowing within one week of sowing a crop.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Record date of sowing within one week
legislation_propositions.label: Record date of sowing within one week

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: Within one week of spreading organic manure, the occupier must record the area on which organic manure is spread, the quantity of organic manure spread, the date or dates, the methods of spreading, the type of organic manure, the total nitrogen content, and the amount of nitrogen that was available to the crop.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Record-keeping obligation for organic manure spreading
legislation_propositions.label: Record-keeping obligation for organic manure spreading

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: Within one week of spreading manufactured nitrogen fertiliser, the occupier must record the date of spreading and the amount of nitrogen spread.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Record-keeping obligation for manufactured nitrogen fertiliser spreading
legislation_propositions.label: Record-keeping obligation for manufactured nitrogen fertiliser spreading

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: The record-keeping obligations in paragraphs (1) and (2) do not apply to the occupier of a holding in any calendar year in which 80% of the agricultural area of the holding is sown with grass and the total nitrogen in organic manure applied is no more than 100 kg per hectare, the total nitrogen in manufactured nitrogen fertiliser applied is no more than 90 kg per hectare, and the occupier does not bring any organic manure onto the holding.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Exception to record-keeping for grass-dominant holdings with low nitrogen application
legislation_propositions.label: Exception to record-keeping for grass-dominant holdings with low nitrogen application

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: An occupier who has used nitrogen fertiliser must record the yield achieved by an arable crop within one week of ascertaining it.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Duty to record arable crop yield after nitrogen fertiliser use
legislation_propositions.label: Duty to record arable crop yield after nitrogen fertiliser use

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: Before 30 April each year an occupier must record how any grassland was managed in the previous calendar year.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Annual duty to record grassland management
legislation_propositions.label: Annual duty to record grassland management

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: An occupier must keep a copy of any advice from a person who is a member of the Fertiliser Advisers Certification and Training Scheme that is relied on for any purpose under these Regulations for five years.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Retention of FACTS adviser advice for five years
legislation_propositions.label: Retention of FACTS adviser advice for five years

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: Any person required to make a record under these Regulations must keep it for five years.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Record retention period
legislation_propositions.label: Record retention period

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: The Welsh Ministers must establish a monitoring programme to assess the effectiveness of the measures imposed by these Regulations as a means of reducing or preventing water pollution from agricultural sources.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Duty to establish monitoring programme for agricultural water pollution measures
legislation_propositions.label: Duty to establish monitoring programme for agricultural water pollution measures

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: At least every four years, the Welsh Ministers must review the effectiveness of the measures imposed by these Regulations as a means of reducing or preventing water pollution from agricultural sources and if necessary revise them.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Duty to review and revise agricultural water pollution measures every four years
legislation_propositions.label: Duty to review and revise agricultural water pollution measures every four years

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: When carrying out a review under paragraph (2), the Welsh Ministers must take into account available scientific and technical data, particularly with reference to respective nitrogen contributions originating from agricultural and other sources.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Duty to consider scientific and technical data on nitrogen contributions in review
legislation_propositions.label: Duty to consider scientific and technical data on nitrogen contributions in review

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: If proposals for an alternative suite of measures for delivering the outcomes in regulation 44(1) are received within 18 months of these Regulations coming into force, the Welsh Ministers must consider whether those measures would deliver the outcomes more effectively than the measures contained in these Regulations.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Duty to consider alternative measures proposals received within 18 months
legislation_propositions.label: Duty to consider alternative measures proposals received within 18 months

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: If the Welsh Ministers are satisfied that proposals submitted under paragraph (1) would be more effective in delivering the outcomes in regulation 44(1), they must publish a statement within two years of these Regulations coming into force, explaining what action will be taken.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Duty to publish statement if alternative proposals more effective
legislation_propositions.label: Duty to publish statement if alternative proposals more effective

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: Any person who contravenes any provision of these Regulations (subject to paragraph (2)) is guilty of an offence and liable on summary conviction, or on conviction on indictment, to a fine.
legislation_propositions.short_name: General offence for contravention of Regulations
legislation_propositions.label: General offence for contravention of Regulations

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: A person who contravenes regulation 32 is guilty of an offence and liable on summary conviction to a fine not exceeding level 2 on the standard scale.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Specific offence for contravention of regulation 32
legislation_propositions.label: Specific offence for contravention of regulation 32

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: Where a body corporate is guilty of an offence under these Regulations, and that offence is proved to have been committed with the consent or connivance of, or attributable to neglect on the part of, any director, manager, secretary or similar person (or person purporting to act in such capacity), that person as well as the body corporate is guilty of the offence and liable to be proceeded against and punished accordingly, subject to paragraph (4).
legislation_propositions.short_name: Corporate officer liability for offences
legislation_propositions.label: Corporate officer liability for offences

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: Paragraph (3) (corporate officer liability) does not apply to contraventions under regulations 24(1), 24(4), 25(1), 30(5) or 32.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Exception to corporate officer liability for specified regulations
legislation_propositions.label: Exception to corporate officer liability for specified regulations

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: The Water Resources (Control of Agricultural Pollution) (Wales) Regulations 2021 are enforced by Natural Resources Wales.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Enforcement by NRW
legislation_propositions.label: Enforcement by NRW

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: The Water Resources (Control of Pollution) (Silage and Slurry) (Wales) Regulations 2010 are revoked on 1 April 2021 in relation to holdings or parts of holdings situated in a nitrate vulnerable zone as shown on the Nitrate Vulnerable Zones Index Map 2013.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Revocation of 2010 Regulations for NVZ holdings
legislation_propositions.label: Revocation of 2010 Regulations for NVZ holdings

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: Regulations 3 and 9 of the Water Resources (Control of Pollution) (Silage and Slurry) (Wales) Regulations 2010 are revoked on 1 April 2021 in relation to all holdings not situated in nitrate vulnerable zones.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Partial revocation of 2010 Regulations for non-NVZ holdings (regs 3 & 9)
legislation_propositions.label: Partial revocation of 2010 Regulations for non-NVZ holdings (regs 3 & 9)

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: All remaining provisions of the Water Resources (Control of Pollution) (Silage and Slurry) (Wales) Regulations 2010 are revoked on 1 August 2024 in relation to all holdings not situated in nitrate vulnerable zones.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Full revocation of 2010 Regulations for non-NVZ holdings (remaining provisions)
legislation_propositions.label: Full revocation of 2010 Regulations for non-NVZ holdings (remaining provisions)

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: The Nitrate Pollution Prevention (Wales) Regulations 2013, the Nitrate Pollution Prevention (Wales) (Amendment) Regulations 2015, and the Nitrate Pollution Prevention (Wales) (Amendment) Regulations 2019 are revoked.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Revocation of Nitrate Pollution Prevention Regulations 2013–2019
legislation_propositions.label: Revocation of Nitrate Pollution Prevention Regulations 2013–2019

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: In the Environmental Permitting (England and Wales) Regulations 2016, Schedule 2, paragraph 17(2)(b), the reference to 'the Nitrate Pollution Prevention (Wales) Regulations 2013' is substituted with 'the Water Resources (Control of Agricultural Pollution) (Wales) Regulations 2021'.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Amendment to Environmental Permitting Regulations 2016 - substitution of reference
legislation_propositions.label: Amendment to Environmental Permitting Regulations 2016 - substitution of reference

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: In the Water Environment (Water Framework Directive) (England and Wales) Regulations 2017, Part 2 of Schedule 2, paragraph 21 is substituted with 'The Water Resources (Control of Agricultural Pollution) (Wales) Regulations 2021'.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Amendment to Water Environment Regulations 2017 - substitution of paragraph 21
legislation_propositions.label: Amendment to Water Environment Regulations 2017 - substitution of paragraph 21

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: In the Water Environment (Water Framework Directive) (England and Wales) Regulations 2017, Part 2 of Schedule 2, paragraph 24 is substituted with 'The Water Resources (Control of Agricultural Pollution) (Wales) Regulations 2021'.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Amendment to Water Environment Regulations 2017 - substitution of paragraph 24
legislation_propositions.label: Amendment to Water Environment Regulations 2017 - substitution of paragraph 24

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: In the Conservation of Habitats and Species (England and Wales) Regulations 2017, regulation 104, paragraph (1)(b) and the 'or' before it are omitted.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Amendment to Conservation of Habitats and Species Regulations 2017 - omission
legislation_propositions.label: Amendment to Conservation of Habitats and Species Regulations 2017 - omission

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: Dairy cows after first calf with an annual milk yield more than 9000 litres produce 64 litres of manure, 315 grams of nitrogen, and 142 grams of phosphate daily.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Daily manure, nitrogen and phosphate production by high-yield dairy cows
legislation_propositions.label: Daily manure, nitrogen and phosphate production by high-yield dairy cows
legislation_propositions.fragment_locator: Schedule 1, Table 1, Cattle - Dairy cows, After first calf, annual milk yield more than 9000 litres

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: Sows (including their litters up to a weight of 7 kg per piglet) fed on a diet supplemented with synthetic amino acids produce 10.9 litres of manure, 44 grams of nitrogen, and 37 grams of phosphate daily.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Daily manure, nitrogen and phosphate production by sows with litters on amino acid-supplemented diet
legislation_propositions.label: Daily manure, nitrogen and phosphate production by sows with litters on amino acid-supplemented diet
legislation_propositions.fragment_locator: Schedule 1, Table 2, Pigs - sows (including their litters up to a weight of 7 kg per piglet) fed on a diet supplemented with synthetic amino acids

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: Pigs weighing from 66 kg and intended for slaughter that are liquid fed produce 10 litres of manure, 33 grams of nitrogen, and 17.9 grams of phosphate daily.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Daily manure, nitrogen and phosphate production by liquid-fed pigs for slaughter (66 kg and over)
legislation_propositions.label: Daily manure, nitrogen and phosphate production by liquid-fed pigs for slaughter (66 kg and over)
legislation_propositions.fragment_locator: Schedule 1, Table 2, Pigs - Weight from 66 kg and—Intended for slaughter—liquid fed

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: Chickens used for production of eggs for human consumption from 17 weeks (not caged) produce 0.12 litres of manure, 1.5 grams of nitrogen, and 1.1 grams of phosphate daily.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Daily manure, nitrogen and phosphate production by non-caged laying hens (17 weeks and over)
legislation_propositions.label: Daily manure, nitrogen and phosphate production by non-caged laying hens (17 weeks and over)
legislation_propositions.fragment_locator: Schedule 1, Table 2, Poultry - Chickens used for production of eggs for human consumption—from 17 weeks (not caged)

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: An occupier of a qualifying grassland holding intending to apply nitrogen in grazing livestock manure exceeding 170 kg per hectare during the relevant period must ensure that the only livestock manure applied to the holding is manure produced by the livestock on that holding.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Livestock manure source restriction for qualifying grassland holdings
legislation_propositions.label: Livestock manure source restriction for qualifying grassland holdings

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: An occupier must undertake soil sampling analysis of at least every five hectares of the agricultural area of the holding with the same cropping regime, nutrient management regime and soil type for the purposes of determining the soil phosphorus index.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Soil sampling analysis requirement for phosphorus indexing
legislation_propositions.label: Soil sampling analysis requirement for phosphorus indexing

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: An occupier must ensure that during the relevant period no person spreads organic manure within 15 metres of surface water unless using precision spreading equipment, in which case no person may spread organic manure within 10 metres of surface water.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Organic manure spreading buffer zones near surface water
legislation_propositions.label: Organic manure spreading buffer zones near surface water

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: If the occupier intends to spread slurry on the holding during the relevant period, precision spreading equipment must be used except where it would not be reasonably practicable to do so.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Precision spreading equipment requirement for slurry
legislation_propositions.label: Precision spreading equipment requirement for slurry

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: Enhanced nutrient management requirements apply to the occupier of a qualifying grassland holding who intends during the relevant period to apply to the holding a total amount of nitrogen in grazing livestock manure which exceeds 170 kg multiplied by the area of the holding in hectares.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Enhanced nutrient management requirements for nitrogen in grazing livestock manure exceeding 170 kg/ha
legislation_propositions.label: Enhanced nutrient management requirements for nitrogen in grazing livestock manure exceeding 170 kg/ha

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: "Soil phosphorus index" means a reference to the index number assigned to the soil in accordance with Table 1 of this Schedule, to indicate the level of phosphorus available from the soil.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Definition of soil phosphorus index
legislation_propositions.label: Definition of soil phosphorus index

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: "Soil sampling analysis" means analysis of a soil sample carried out by a soil testing laboratory to analyse soils for phosphorus.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Definition of soil sampling analysis
legislation_propositions.label: Definition of soil sampling analysis

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: The occupier must ensure that the only livestock manure applied to the holding during the relevant period is manure produced by the livestock on the holding.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Livestock manure source restriction for qualifying grassland holdings
legislation_propositions.label: Livestock manure source restriction for qualifying grassland holdings

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: The occupier must undertake soil sampling analysis of at least every five hectares of the agricultural area of the holding with the same cropping regime, nutrient management regime and soil type for the purposes of determining the soil phosphorus index for each area of the holding.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Soil sampling analysis requirement for phosphorus index determination
legislation_propositions.label: Soil sampling analysis requirement for phosphorus index determination

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: An occupier may rely on the results of previous soil sampling analysis of the agricultural area of the holding with the same cropping regime, nutrient management regime and soil type, provided such sampling analysis was carried out within the period beginning with 1 January 2020 and ending with 31 December 2023.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Reliance on previous soil sampling analysis (2020-2023 period)
legislation_propositions.label: Reliance on previous soil sampling analysis (2020-2023 period)

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: Where phosphorus soil sampling analysis of the agricultural area of the holding with the same cropping regime, nutrient management regime and soil type has not been carried out within the period 1 January 2020 to 31 December 2023, such sampling analysis must be undertaken within the period beginning with 1 January 2024 and ending with 30 March 2024.
legislation_propositions.short_name: Mandatory soil sampling deadline where no prior analysis exists
legislation_propositions.label: Mandatory soil sampling deadline where no prior analysis exists

legislation_propositions.proposition_text: The occupier must determine the soil phosphorus index for each area of the holding with the same cropping regime, nutrient management regime and soil type by using the results from soil sampling analysis and the values in Table 1 (Phosphorus index).
legislation_propositions.short_name: Determination of soil phosphorus index by occupier
legislation_propositions.label: Determination of soil phosphorus index by occupier
